description: AlphaGenome Atlas AVI (bulk-download mirror): all SNVs in a region with AVI score + PHRED + percentile, from the same local mirror. Costs 3 tool units per 1 kb window when served; upstream_unavailable charges nothing. Requires your agent key.

auth.description: Your agent key (awk_ + 32 hex) from aw_register. Required on stdio. Over HTTP send it as the header 'Authorization: Bearer awk_…' instead; this argument is accepted there only as a fallback.

end.description: 1-based end, at most 10000 bp past start.

name: aw_atlas_scan_region
